scope: SCRUM-71, OANDA UK/live US30_USD and DE30_EUR calendar verification only

request.range: requested_day UTC minus four hours; two-day half-open window
request.authentication: Local credentials used in memory; no credentials, identifiers, account financial data or OHLC responses retained

cautions: These are observed timestamp envelopes, not a classification of all missing minutes or proof that every minute traded.
Small within-session gaps were compacted for readable manual diagnostics; larger gaps are preserved as observations and must not automatically become calendar exceptions.
A returned timestamp identifies a completed candle interval start. end_exclusive is last returned interval start plus one minute.
The 2025-11-28 outage-like overnight gap is NOT a scheduled closure in the profile.
This is sampled manual verification, not a full three-year import, dataset checksum, or assertion of complete holiday master data.
